added.member: UI documents: components and snippets in mounted documents
added.summary: A capitalised tag instantiates a component document in a scope.mount: its props are the user's expressions read in the user's context (bind: writes back), snippets inside the instance and its other children (`children`) are content rendered by {@render name()} in the context they were written in; {#each} iterates a collection passed as a prop.
A fourth argument passes content by reference: a name the document renders with {@render name()}, mapped to a document (its root) or `document#snippet`.
